title: Personal radar: questions, evidence, and quarter focus
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for my upcoming 1:1s, calibration prep, and the items I want my manager to notice. Not polished — literal notes-to-self and evidence snippets I can paste into a review or deck.

Top 3 quarter focus (what success looks like):
1) Reduce onboarding time for new hires on ops team by 20% — target = baseline 6.2 days -> 5 days. Evidence: new onboarding checklist v2 (linked PR), pilot cohort (3 hires) completed ramp survey avg 4.1/5 (vs 3.2 baseline). TODO: share cohort survey breakdown in 1:1.
2) Stabilize weekly case backlog (L2 escalations) to <= 12 open items consistently. Evidence: backlog trend CSV (confluence page), last 3 weeks avg = 11.6. Need help getting one extra headcount to sustain.
3) Ship manager enablement workshop + templates (measurable adoption: 40% of managers used template in first month). Evidence: workshop recording + template uses in Slack (search: "onboard-template v2").

Recent wins (quick bullets I can use in calibration):
- Led cross-functional pilot that cut infra incident MTTR from 4.2h to 2.1h (SRE + infra + ops coordination). Anecdote: staged runbook dry-run on Feb 10 -> no customer downtime; flagged gap in runbook step 3 and updated.
- Negotiated scope with Legal to reduce signing time for contractor agreements from 9 days -> 3 days by templating standard clauses.
- Two managers sent private notes praising the new one-pager for hiring debriefs (copy/paste available).

Evidence snippets to paste: metrics lines and links (keep handy)
- Onboarding time: pilot cohort ramp survey link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PE/onboarding-pilot-2026
- MTTR reduction: incident dashboard snapshot (ID: inc-2026-0210)
- Contract cycle time: JIRA HR-412 (epic) -> workflow changes applied 2026-01-26

Manager asks (explicit):
- Priority ask: headcount approval for +1 ops generalist (justify with backlog numbers + planned hires).
- Career ask: clear roadmap to Sr. People Ops (what signals they want: scope, leadership moments, OKRs I should own).
- Support ask: help escalate one blocker with infra procurement (ticket #INF-297) if needed.

Calibration prep (short answers I plan to give):
Q: What impact did you own? A: Narrowed major cross-team friction -> reduced time-to-resolution for infra-support by ~50% for class B incidents; also shipped manager templates used by 6 managers in week 1.
Q: Where did things fall short? A: Onboarding automation — initial attempt missed LDAP edge cases; knocked back another sprint. Plan: pair with infra to ship fix in March.

Risks and mitigations: 
- Risk: backlog spikes if we lose a senior on-call. Mitigation: cross-train two ICs by end of month; draft rotation schedule attached.
- Risk: workshop adoption is slow. Mitigation: schedule 15-min followups and embed templates into manager weekly cadence.

Feedback I want from manager in 1:1: concrete examples of where I demonstrated leadership, and one small behavior to stop/start/continue. Also ask for a shortlist of stretch projects that would signal readiness for Sr role.

Quick to-dos before sync (tick-boxes):
- [ ] Drop the onboarding survey link in the doc I send this week.
- [ ] Prepare 2-3 slides with backlog trend + hire ask.
- [ ] Pull the incident MTTR graph and a 1-sentence summary for calibration form.

Notes-to-self / loose questions:
- Should I include raw survey comments in the packet or anonymized summary? My instinct = anonymized + 2 short quotes.
- Look up compensation band for Sr people ops to ensure ask is framed against market.

End — simple working doc. Keep short, editable, and ready to copy/paste into manager emails or calibration forms.

References in my head: confluence onboarding pilot, JIRA HR-412, incident inc-2026-0210, INF-297.
